town.text: Mm. Bring me the steel. I'll see what's left in the fire.
town.direction: deep, rough, slow; a grunt before the words

town.text: Forge is cold this morning. Colder than yesterday.
Hm. That edge has seen work. Leave it with me.
Don't ask where the last shard came from. I didn't.
Mm. Good steel remembers the hammer. Better than I do, some days.
Four Fells at this anvil before me. I'll not be the one lets it go out.
town.direction: slower still; he doesn't say this lightly

town.text: Shut the door. You're letting the heat out. What's left of it.
